theater: 撒馬爾罕、不花剌與玉龍傑赤

battle.name: 河中之戰
battle.theater: 撒馬爾罕、不花剌與玉龍傑赤
battle.brief: 成吉思汗十四年九月起，蒙古軍越過錫爾河，分四路進擊花剌子模的河中：察合台、窩闊台圍訛答剌半年，術赤取西北三城，中路穿沙漠直取不花剌，終以合圍迫撒馬爾罕守軍出降，再圍六個月而下玉龍傑赤。卡面的十字弩不在蒙古騎兵手中，它屬城頭與圍城步兵的火砲，攻城靠的是投石機、撞車與雲梯。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 河中之戰是成吉思汗十四年（1219）九月起、至十六年（1221）二月止，蒙古第一次西征在河中地區所打的一組戰役。河中指錫爾河與阿姆河之間的兩河流域，即中亞的馬維拉－納赫爾，錫爾河沿岸與阿姆河下游的大城密集，是花剌子模的糧倉與工商之地。交戰一方是蒙古帝國：成吉思汗以本部怯薛與草原部落兵為骨幹，四路大軍中夾雜大量漢地與西域的降附者、匠人與攻城技師，軍行極速，攻城時依賤隨軍工匠造出的雲梯、撞車、攻城塔與投石機。另一方是花剌子模帝國：大汗摩訶末調動全國徵發兵，總數漢籍記為四十萬，分散駐守錫爾河沿岸的城塞，把兵力的重心放在新都撒馬爾罕與舊都玉龍傑赤兩座城上，企圖分兵自守、待敵疲餓再相機反攻。花剌子模的軍隊以花剌子模契丹（吉爾伽斯人）與土庫曼人（阿爾斯蘭）為主，步兵扛短標槍與長矛，騎兵配複合弓與鎖子甲、札甲，城防以土坯與磚牆築成，牆上列有塔樓，並備拋石與弩。兩軍的戰爭樣式差異極大：蒙古是機動作戰加攻城攻堅，花剌子模則以城塞為堡壘、以徵發兵守城。
countriesEn: The Battle of Transoxiana was a group of engagements fought in the country of Mawar al-Nahr, the river land between the Syr Darya and the Amu Darya in Central Asia, from the ninth month of the fourteenth year of Genghis Khan (September 1219) to the second month of the sixteenth year (February 1221), as part of the first Mongol campaign to the west. The great cities along the Syr Darya and the lower Amu Darya stood thickly here, for this was the granary and the land of craftsmen and merchants of Khwarezm. One side was the Mongol empire: the backbone of Genghis Khan's army was the keshig guard together with the levies of the steppe tribes, and the four columns that marched into Khwarezmian territory carried with them large numbers of men surrendered or conscripted in China and in the western regions, together with artisans and siege engineers. The army moved with enormous speed, and when it halted before a walled town it relied on the ladders, battering rams, siege towers and stone-throwers built on the spot by the craftsmen it carried with it. The other side was the Khwarezmian empire. The Shah, Muhammad, mobilised the levies of the whole state, recorded in the Chinese annals as four hundred thousand men, and scattered them among the fortified towns along the Syr Darya, placing the weight of his force on the two capitals, the new capital Samarqand and the old capital Urgench, in the hope of holding each city separately, letting the enemy wear themselves out, and then counter-attacking in his own time. The Khwarezmian army was composed chiefly of Khwarazmian Qipchaq and Turkmen levies: foot soldiers carrying short javelins and long spears, horsemen armed with composite bows and wearing mail and lamellar armour. Their town defences were walls of mud brick and fired brick crowned with towers, furnished with stone-throwers and crossbows. The two systems of war were in every respect unlike: the Mongols fought a war of movement and of siege assault, while Khwarezm fought from behind its fortresses with conscript infantry.
people: 成吉思汗是這場戰役全場的統帥。他面對的是摩訶末的四十大軍，主力卻拒絕在錫爾河東岸與之硬碰：先分兵四出，逐一吃掉沿線城鎮，中路作大縱深迂回，穿過基吉爾庫姆沙漠直插阿姆河流域，最後與各路在撒馬爾罕會合，把摩訶末連同他的國土一起包在裡面。他身邊帶著三個兒子：長子朮赤領第二路，沿錫爾河西北取昔格那克、氈的、養吉干三城；次子察合台與三子窩闊台領第一路圍攻訛答剌，先以六個月困死守軍再強取；三子之弟拖雷隨中路穿越沙漠。哲別另率五千騎為奇兵，自南方插入花剌子模東南，切斷其與阿富汗、呼羅珊的聯繫；摩訶末逃走後，哲別、速不台、脫忽察兒各將一萬騎追之不捨，速不台由此嶄露頭角，後來成為西征歐洲的統帥之一。第三路由阿剌黑、速亦客禿、塔孩三人分領，攻伯納克忒與忽毡。花剌子模方面，摩訶末的判斷是全場的關鍵：他不相信蒙古人會長期駐留，於是放棄阿姆河東岸，收縮到撒馬爾罕，最後連撒馬爾罕也放棄，帶殘部西逃印度，最終死於途中。
peopleEn: Genghis Khan was the commander of the entire operation. Faced with Muhammad's four hundred thousand men, he refused to commit his main force to a set-piece struggle on the eastern bank of the Syr Darya. Instead he split his army four ways, consumed the towns along the line one at a time, and pushed the central column deep, through the Kyzylkum desert into the basin of the Amu Darya, joining the other columns at Samarqand and enclosing Muhammad together with his country. He had three of his sons with him. The eldest, Jochi, led the second column along the north-west of the Syr Darya and took the three towns of Siqnaq, Jand and Yangi Kan. Chagatai and the third son Ögedei led the first column against Otrar, where they spent six months shutting the garrison in before storming the place. Tolui, the youngest of the three, rode with the central column across the desert. Jebe was given a separate force of five thousand horsemen to operate as a raiding column in the south-east of Khwarezmian territory, cutting the kingdom off from Afghanistan and Khurasan; when Muhammad fled, Jebe, Subutai and Toqto'a each pursued him with ten thousand riders. Subutai made his name here and was later to be one of the commanders of the campaign into Europe. The third column was shared out among Alaqa, Su'beitü and Ta'qa, who took Berbent and Khujand. On the Khwarezmian side the crucial judgement was Muhammad's own: he did not believe the Mongols would stay once they had stripped the plains of Transoxiana, so he gave up the eastern bank of the Amu Darya, contracted to Samarqand, and finally abandoned Samarqand as well, fleeing west with the remnants of his army and dying on the road.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是十字弩——弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢；城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。十三世紀的弩在歐亞並非冷門：中原的宋與金以弩為步軍常備火器，弩手列於前排固定發射，長槍手居其後承擔近戰，刀兵護住兩翼，金軍更有以弩為主的專門編制；西征軍中的弩，則多來自被征服地區徵集的漢人與回回工匠所攜。放在河中之戰裡看，弩的位置十分清楚：它不在蒙古騎兵手上——蒙古軍的骨幹是複合弓騎射，野外奔馳時既無需也不便使用弩——它屬於城頭與圍城步兵的火力。訛答剌、撒馬爾罕、玉龍傑赤這類土坯高牆上的守軍，靠的正是弩箭壓制進攻者的雲梯隊；突圍與反擊的步兵也以弩手在前、長槍手在後結陣。花剌子模的裝備以複合弓、短標槍、長矛與鎧甲為主，牆上另有拋石機與石砲。進攻一方的攻城器械則是雲梯、撞車、穴地、攻城塔與投石機：蒙古軍的投石射程足以壓制城頭，但要真正把守軍從石牆上趕走，仍然要靠雲梯與隨之突進的步兵，而那些步兵的骨干便是弩手。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the crossbow — the mechanism took over the rate of fire, and the price was slow reloading; on a wall it was more reliable than the long bow, in open field it was more fragile. In the thirteenth century the crossbow was by no means an oddity across Eurasia. Song and Jin China in the central plains carried it as a standard arm of the infantry: crossbowmen stood in the front rank and fired from a fixed rest, spearmen stood behind them to carry the close work, and sword and shield troops covered the flanks; the Jin had in fact formations composed chiefly of crossbowmen. The crossbows carried in the western campaign came for the most part with Han and Huihui artisans conscripted in the conquered regions. Placed inside the Battle of Transoxiana the position of the crossbow is quite clear. It was not in the hands of the Mongol horsemen — the backbone of their army was composite-bow archery from horseback, and in the field they had neither need nor convenience for a crossbow — it belonged to the wall tops and to the infantry of a siege. The garrisons of Otrar, Samarqand and Urgench, standing on tall mud-brick walls, relied on crossbow bolts to shoot down the ladders of the attackers, and their sortie infantry closed in the same way, crossbowmen in front and spearmen behind. The Khwarezmian equipment list ran to composite bows, short javelins, long spears and armour, with stone-throwers on the walls. The besiegers' own equipment was the ladder, the battering ram, the sap, the siege tower and the stone-thrower: the Mongol trebuchets had the range to dominate the parapet, but to drive the garrison off the stone in earnest the assault still depended on the ladders and on the infantry that came up behind them, and the backbone of that infantry was the crossbow.
tactics: 蒙古的戰法一句話可以說清：分進合擊，個個殲滅，不與敵主力在野外作消耗對抗。一二一九年九月過錫爾河之後，大軍裂成四路。察合台、窩闊台一路直取訛答剌，用雲梯與投石機攻了六個月，時間花在截斷援軍與消耗城內存水上；朮赤一路沿錫爾河西北掃過昔格那克、氈的、養吉干三城；阿剌黑等一路取東南的伯納克忒與忽毡；成吉思汗自將中路，與拖雷率騎兵通過基吉爾庫姆沙漠那段缺水地帶，奪賽爾奴克、訥兒城，直抵不花剌。守軍自始至终沒有得到集中決戰的機會，兩路會師撒馬爾罕時，城外已是蒙古大營環列。包圍之後，蒙古軍做的是三件事：斷絕外援、驅走援軍、以投石與圍城把守軍壓到投降。第三日守軍出降，是攻城史上罕見的局面。摩訶末逃走，哲別等三路各率一萬騎緊追，攻城與追擊同時進行，戰線因此拉成數百里的追逃。玉龍傑赤的圍城最久，歷時六個多月，其間守軍多次出城反擊皆被壓回，最終在一次夜襲中被撕開缺口，城破之後，蒙古軍以決水與巷戰殲滅守軍。
tacticsEn: The Mongol method can be stated in a sentence: divide and converge, destroy each in turn, and never trade away the army in a long attrition fight in the open. After crossing the Syr Darya in September 1219 the great army split into four. Chagatai and Ögedei went straight for Otrar and spent six months on it with ladders and stone-throwers, the time being used to cut off relief and to eat away at the stores inside the walls. Jochi's column swept the three towns of Siqnaq, Jand and Yangi Kan along the north-west of the Syr Darya. The column of Alaqa and the others took Berbent and Khujand in the south-east. Genghis Khan himself led the central route, riding with Tolui across the waterless stretch of the Kyzylkum desert, seizing Termez and Nul, and pressing on to Bukhara. The defenders were never given the chance to bring their strength together for a decisive battle; by the time the two columns met at Samarqand, the Mongol camps already ringed the city. Once the investment was complete the Mongols did three things: they cut the place off from outside, they drove off the relieving armies, and they used stone-throwers and the blockade to squeeze the garrison into surrender. That the garrison came out on the third day is a rare thing in the history of siege. Muhammad fled, and Jebe with his two companions pursued him with ten thousand riders each, so that siege and pursuit went forward at once and the front was drawn out into a chase of several hundred li. The siege of Urgench lasted longest, more than six months; the garrison sallied out again and again and was pressed back each time, until a night assault tore a breach in the wall, after which the Mongols drowned the defenders with the waters let in and finished them in the streets.
data: 兵員方面，漢籍記載與實際規模之間的差距必須先說清楚：花剌子模大汗摩訶末動員的四十萬人，是全國徵發兵員的總數，實際能列陣作戰的當遠少於此；蒙古第一次西征的兵員，一般記在十萬上下，其中撒馬爾罕一線的會師兵力最集中。可核對的局部數字有幾個：訛答剌城破時守軍被消滅約三萬，不花剌城破時守軍被消滅約三萬，撒馬爾罕被圍後第三日出降的守軍十一萬，玉龍傑赤城破後守軍被消滅約九萬，全役下來漢籍計花剌子模正規軍被消滅約三十萬——這組數字出自中國史籍的戰果統計，方向可信而絕對值應當打折看待。時間線是：1219年九月越過錫爾河，1220年二月訛答剌城破、三月不花剌城破並完成對撒馬爾罕的合圍，1221年二月玉龍傑赤城破，戰役至此結束。圍城時長方面，訛答剌歷時約六個月，玉龍傑赤六個多月。距離上，撒馬爾罕至不花剌約二百五十公里，玉龍傑赤在阿姆河下游，離撒馬爾罕約六百餘公里，蒙古軍在這樣的縱深上作戰，靠的是逐水草而行的騎隊與駱駝馱運。
dataEn: On the figures for troops, the gap between the Chinese records and the real scale of the armies must be stated first. The four hundred thousand men mobilised by the Shah of Khwarezm, Muhammad, was a total of levies drawn from the whole state; the number who could actually be brought into the line was far smaller. The size of the Mongols in their first campaign to the west is generally put at around one hundred thousand, of whom the concentration outside Samarqand was the largest single body. There are several local figures that can be checked. At Otrar some thirty thousand of the garrison were destroyed when the city fell; at Bukhara some thirty thousand of the garrison were destroyed; at Samarqand one hundred and ten thousand of the garrison came out to surrender on the third day after the investment; and at Urgench some ninety thousand of the garrison were destroyed when the city fell. For the campaign as a whole the Chinese annals count about three hundred thousand of the regular army of Khwarezm destroyed. That set of figures comes from the Chinese account of the results of the fighting: the direction is credible, but the absolute values should be discounted. The time sequence runs: the Syr Darya was crossed in September 1219; Otrar fell in February 1220; Bukhara fell in March 1220 and the investment of Samarqand was completed in the same month; Urgench fell in February 1221, and with it the campaign was over. As to the duration of the sieges, Otrar took about six months and Urgench rather more than six. In distance, Samarqand lies about two hundred and fifty kilometres from Bukhara, while Urgench is on the lower Amu Darya some six hundred kilometres or more from Samarqand; an army fighting on that depth of penetration lived on moving with the pastures, its horse columns and its camel trains.
cause: 打起來的原因有遠近兩層。遠的一層是草原與中亞的貿易糾紛：蒙古與花剌子模之間，商人、匠人與使節往來不絕，花剌子模的權臣以財政名義截留商隊、徵收重稅，一二一八年蒙古派往花剌子模的商隊與使者被殺於訛答剌一帶，這件事成了成吉思汗動兵的公開藉口。近的一層是摩訶末本人的戰略判斷：他不相信蒙古人會在劫掠完河中平原之後留下來，於是採用主動放棄、堅壁清野的辦法，把防線從阿姆河一線退到錫爾河，把兵力和國都押在撒馬爾罕上，以為只要守得住兩都、拖住蒙古人，蒙古人就會像歷來的草原掠奪者那樣帶著戰利品離去。這一判斷方向全錯：蒙古人不但留下來，而且正是因為花剌子模的城塞集中、糧草集中、指揮集中，才讓成吉思汗得以分兵把每一座城單獨拔掉，最後把整個王國的主體一口吞下。
causeEn: The war had a near cause and a distant one. The distant cause lay in the commercial friction between the steppe and Central Asia. Merchants, craftsmen and envoys passed constantly between the Mongols and Khwarezm; the Khwarezmian authorities intercepted caravans on fiscal pretexts and levied heavy dues, and in 1218 a Mongol caravan and its envoys were killed in the neighbourhood of Otrar, an affair that became the public pretext for Genghis Khan's war. The near cause was the strategic judgement of Muhammad himself. He did not believe the Mongols would remain after stripping the plains of Transoxiana, so he adopted a policy of deliberate abandonment and of burning the land, withdrawing his line from the Amu Darya back to the Syr Darya and staking his troops and his capital on Samarqand. He thought that if he could hold the two capitals and hold the Mongols in front of them, the Mongols would depart as the steppe raiders had always done, taking their plunder with them. The judgement was wrong in its every particular. The Mongols not only stayed, but precisely because the Khwarezmian cities, its grain and its command were all concentrated, Genghis Khan was able to detach a column against each town separately and finally swallow the whole substance of the state in one bite.
impact: 這一役之後花剌子模帝國從此瓦解。摩訶末帶著殘部逃到阿姆河下游，越過印度河，於一二二一年或一二二三年死在逃亡途中；帝國西部，即河中這片最富庶的農業區與手工業城市，盡數落入蒙古人之手，後來成為察合台汗國與窩闊台汗國的西翼。花剌子模一脈並未全滅，摩訶末之子札闌丁在波斯與印度河流域又堅持了兩年，終於在一二二一年的印度河之戰後被消滅。對西方伊斯蘭世界，這是一場天塌下來的大地震：花剌子模的覆亡與蒙古軍繼續西進的傳聞，令西亞諸國連夜築城，並把札闌丁的抵抗視為整個穆斯林世界最後的指望。更深遠的一層影響在技術與制度：蒙古軍在河中第一次成規模地取得攻城工程技術與被征服地區的匠人隊伍，此後進攻西夏、金、西亞的堅城都有投射砲、攻城塔與配重式投石機可用；隨軍的漢人、回回工匠與被擄走的技師又隨軍隊回流到蒙古本部，使蒙古帝國的攻城能力在十二、十三世紀之交發生質變。弩這類步軍火器也在同一過程中進入蒙古軍的體系，日後與漢軍的長槍、刀盾合成為攻城與守城的標準配置。
impactEn: With this campaign the Khwarezmian empire was broken. Muhammad fled with the remnants of his forces to the lower Amu Darya, crossed the Indus, and died on the road in 1221 or 1223. The western half of the empire, that is the richest agricultural district and the cities of craftsmen in Transoxiana, passed wholly to the Mongols, and later became the western wing of the domains of Chagatai and Ögedei. The Khwarezmian line was not wholly destroyed: Muhammad's son Jalal al-Din held out for two more years in Persia and along the Indus, and was finally annihilated after the battle on the Indus in 1221. For the Islamic world of the West this was an earthquake. The fall of Khwarezm and the reports of Mongol columns continuing westward set the states of western Asia to raising walls in a single night, and Jalal al-Din's resistance came to be regarded as the last hope of the Muslim world. The deeper legacy lay in technique and institutions. In Transoxiana the Mongol army for the first time acquired, on a large scale, both the engineering of siegecraft and bodies of craftsmen taken from the conquered regions; from then on, when the Mongols stormed the fortresses of Western Xia, of Jin and of western Asia, they had stone-throwers, siege towers and counterweight trebuchets at hand. Han and Huihui craftsmen who marched with the columns, and technicians carried off in the raids, flowed back with the armies into the Mongol heartland, and the siege capability of the Mongol empire changed in quality at the turn of the twelfth and thirteenth centuries. Crossbows and other infantry fire weapons entered the Mongol order of battle by the same process, and were afterwards combined with the long spears and the sword and shield of the Han infantry to form the standard equipment of the assault on a walled town and of its defence.
result: 結果沒有含糊：河中三座大城全部易手。1219年九月起兵，1220年二月訛答剌城破，察合台、窩闊台以六個月的圍困換來這座城，與此同時朮赤與阿剌黑兩路把錫爾河兩側的城鎮逐個拔除；1220年三月不花剌城破，中路大軍隨即插到撒馬爾罕背後完成戰略包圍，圍城第三日守軍十一萬出降；1221年二月，圍了六個多月的玉龍傑赤終於陷落，河中戰役以花剌子模正規軍約三十萬被消滅、中亞兩河之間的防線徹底崩潰作結。勝負的關鍵有三：一是拒絕在野外同花剌子模主力硬碰，把戰爭主動權握在手上；二是敢於把大軍分成四路深入數百里，以時間換取各個擊破；三是攻城與追擊兩手同時進行，摩訶末的西逃沒有換來任何喘息的空間。剩下的只是收拾殘局：哲別、速不台、脫忽察兒各率一萬騎追入印度河流域，到一二二一年底，蒙古第一次西征的第一階段才算真正結束，戰爭的下一階段轉向對花剌子模殘部的追滅與對西亞的遠征。
resultEn: The result admits of no ambiguity: all three great cities of Transoxiana changed hands. The campaign opened in September 1219; Otrar fell in February 1220, and Chagatai and Ögedei had bought that town with six months of blockade, while at the same time the columns of Jochi and Alaqa pulled down the towns on both sides of the Syr Darya one after another. In March 1220 Bukhara fell, and the central army pushed in behind Samarqand to complete the strategic encirclement; on the third day of the siege one hundred and ten thousand of the garrison came out to surrender. In February 1221 Urgench, besieged for more than six months, at last fell, and with it the Battle of Transoxiana ended: some three hundred thousand of the regular army of Khwarezm destroyed, the whole defensive line between the two rivers of Central Asia broken. Three things decided it. First, the refusal to meet the Khwarezmian main force in the open country, which kept the initiative in Mongol hands. Second, the boldness to split the great army into four columns and drive them hundreds of li deep, trading time for the destruction of one enemy at a time. Third, the conduct of siege and pursuit at the same moment, which left Muhammad's flight west no breathing space whatever. What remained was only the mopping up: Jebe, Subutai and Toqto'a each led ten thousand riders after him into the basin of the Indus, and only at the close of 1221 was the first stage of the first Mongol campaign to the west properly finished, the war passing on to the destruction of the remnants of Khwarezm and to the distant expedition into western Asia.
